title: Integration breaks down in unconscious states at layer 5 neurons

statements.text: Measures such as the perturbational complexity index show a breakdown of effective connectivity in deep sleep and anesthesia. The theory predicts that the reason information integration breaks down in the unconscious state lies in layer 5 pyramidal neurons and their interactions with the thalamo-cortical system.

sources.quote: we predict that the central reason for why information integration breaks down in the unconscious state is to be found on the level of L5p neurons
